Tier-1 Alert Triage & Routing.description: Comprehensive SOC Tier-1 alert evaluation covering true/false positive probability, malicious intent, queue routing, containment urgency, and severity scoring.

is_true_positive.instructions: Does the security alert and associated telemetry represent unauthorized, suspicious, or malicious activity rather than benign administrative or operational noise?

criteria.true_description: Indicators of compromise, suspicious command execution, policy violation, unauthorized access, or anomalous behavior requiring security investigation.
criteria.false_description: Routine administrative activity, known scanner/health check, expected scheduled job, or benign baseline user behavior.

malicious_intent_detected.instructions: Are there explicit signs of attacker tradecraft such as obfuscation, privilege escalation, credential theft, C2 communication, or living-off-the-land (LOLBin) abuse?

criteria.true_description: Encoded/obfuscated scripts, payload downloads, credential dumping, persistence mechanisms, lateral movement, or known malicious IOCs.
criteria.false_description: Standard administrative tools used normally without evasion or malicious indicators.

recommended_queue.instructions: Which SOC operational queue is best suited to handle this alert based on the observed evidence?

criteria.auto_close_benign: Clearly benign operational noise or verified false positive requiring no analyst action.
criteria.tier1_standard_triage: Ambiguous or low-to-medium severity activity requiring initial Tier-1 analyst verification.
criteria.tier2_incident_response: High-confidence malicious activity, active compromise, malware execution, or lateral movement requiring immediate Tier-2 IR.
criteria.threat_hunting: Complex behavioral anomaly or subtle precursor activity suited for proactive Threat Hunting correlation.
criteria.vulnerability_management: Misconfiguration or unpatched exposure without active exploitation.

containment_action.instructions: What immediate automated or analyst-approved containment action is most appropriate?

criteria.no_action_needed: Activity appears benign; no containment required.
criteria.monitor_and_enrich: Gather additional SIEM telemetry and entity enrichment before taking disruptive action.
criteria.isolate_endpoint: Active host compromise or malware execution requiring network isolation of the endpoint.
criteria.suspend_user_identity: Compromised credentials, impossible travel, or IAM abuse requiring account suspension/password reset.
criteria.block_external_ioc: Outbound C2 or malicious external IP/domain communication requiring firewall/EDR block.

severity_rubric.instructions: Rate the operational security severity of this alert against the SOC rubric.
criteria: Informational / Benign: Expected operational behavior or non-security event.
Low Severity: Minor policy deviation or isolated reconnaissance with no system impact.
Medium Severity: Suspicious execution, anomalous authentication, or unverified threat indicator requiring investigation.
High / Critical Severity: Active exploitation, malware execution, credential compromise, or data exfiltration.

requires_deep_adk_investigation.instructions: Does this case exhibit multi-stage attack progression, silent YARA-L detections, suspicious command lines, or ambiguity that warrants a deep multi-turn AI investigation?

criteria.true_description: Multi-stage attack indicators, silent YARA-L detections, lateral movement, or investigative ambiguity requiring deep multi-turn analysis.
criteria.false_description: Single isolated false-positive or routine benign activity with zero correlated silent detections.

Phishing & Email Security Gate.description: Evaluates reported emails, headers, URLs, and rendered screenshots for credential harvesting, BEC impersonation, payload delivery, and quarantine disposition.

is_credential_harvesting.instructions: Does the message attempt to deceive the recipient into entering credentials, MFA codes, or session tokens on an external or lookalike site?

criteria.true_description: Contains deceptive login links, fake SSO prompts, urgent password expiry claims, or brand impersonation targeting credentials.
criteria.false_description: No credential solicitation or deceptive login links present.

is_bec_or_impersonation.instructions: Does the message exhibit Business Email Compromise (BEC), executive impersonation, or fraudulent invoice/wire transfer requests?

criteria.true_description: Impersonates an executive, vendor, or colleague requesting urgent financial transfers, gift cards, payroll changes, or sensitive documents.
criteria.false_description: Standard business correspondence, marketing newsletter, or non-impersonation message.

contains_malicious_link_or_attachment.instructions: Are there suspicious URLs, shortened/redirected links, executable/macro attachments, or archive payloads referenced in the email?

criteria.true_description: Contains suspicious domains, newly registered links, HTML smuggling, ISO/ZIP/LNK attachments, or macro-enabled documents.
criteria.false_description: Links and attachments point to verified corporate domains or are absent.

email_disposition.instructions: What disposition should the email security playbook apply to this message?

criteria.deliver_legitimate: Legitimate business or transactional email; mark safe and release.
criteria.quarantine_spam_marketing: Unsolicited commercial spam or graymail without security threat.
criteria.quarantine_phishing_and_purge: Confirmed phishing or malicious payload; quarantine and purge from all recipient mailboxes.
criteria.escalate_compromised_sender: Internal or trusted partner account appears compromised; escalate to SOC Incident Response.

phishing_risk_score.instructions: Rate the overall phishing and social engineering risk level of the inspected message.
criteria: Safe / Legitimate: Verified sender and normal business content.
Low Risk / Graymail: Bulk marketing or cold outreach with no deceptive indicators.
Suspicious / Probable Phishing: Social engineering urgency, sender mismatch, or questionable links.
Critical Phishing / Active Attack: High-confidence credential harvester, malware delivery, or targeted BEC fraud.

Command-Line & Script Risk Assessment.description: Analyzes process command lines, PowerShell, Bash, or script blocks for obfuscation, LOLBin abuse, MITRE ATT&CK tactic classification, and execution risk.

is_obfuscated_or_encoded.instructions: Does the command line or script use Base64 encoding, string concatenation, XOR/compression, environment variable slicing, or other obfuscation techniques?

criteria.true_description: Uses -enc/-EncodedCommand, Base64 blobs, Invoke-Expression (IEX), charCode conversion, or deliberate syntax obfuscation.
criteria.false_description: Clear-text arguments and standard readable script parameters.

is_lolbin_abuse.instructions: Does the command abuse a legitimate operating system binary (LOLBin/GTFOBin) for proxy execution, payload download, or defense evasion?

criteria.true_description: Abuses powershell, certutil, mshta, rundll32, regsvr32, bitsadmin, wmic, curl, or bash for anomalous execution or download.
criteria.false_description: Standard application binary or routine administrative usage.

downloads_or_executes_external_payload.instructions: Does the command attempt to fetch, decode, or execute code from an external IP address, domain, or temporary staging path?

criteria.true_description: Initiates WebClient/Invoke-WebRequest/curl/wget downloads, decodes staged files in Temp/AppData/dev/shm, or executes remote scripts in memory.
criteria.false_description: Operates strictly on local trusted paths without external payload retrieval.

primary_mitre_tactic.instructions: Which primary MITRE ATT&CK tactic best characterizes this command line or script activity?

criteria.benign_administration: Routine system administration, patching, or configuration management.
criteria.execution: Running malicious or unauthorized code, scripts, or scheduled tasks (TA0002).
criteria.persistence: Creating services, registry run keys, cron jobs, or startup items (TA0003).
criteria.privilege_escalation: Bypassing UAC, exploiting sudo/setuid, or elevating token privileges (TA0004).
criteria.defense_evasion: Disabling security tools, clearing logs, masquerading, or decoding payloads (TA0005).
criteria.credential_access: Dumping LSASS, SAM, NTDS.dit, browser stores, or cloud credentials (TA0006).
criteria.discovery: Enumerating users, domain trusts, network shares, or processes (TA0007).
criteria.lateral_movement: Remote execution via WinRM, SMB/PsExec, WMI, SSH, or RDP (TA0008).
criteria.command_and_control: Establishing reverse shells, beacons, or encrypted tunnels (TA0011).

script_risk_score.instructions: Rate the maliciousness and operational risk of this command line or script execution.
criteria: Benign: Standard administrative or application command line.
Low Risk: Diagnostic or enumeration command (`whoami`, `ipconfig`, `netstat`) warranting context check.
High Risk: Suspicious LOLBin usage, abnormal parent-child process tree, or unauthorized configuration change.
Critical Malicious: Obfuscated cradle, credential dumping, reverse shell, or active malware payload execution.

DLP & Data Exfiltration Policy Gate.description: Evaluates outbound network transfers, cloud storage uploads, and DLP alerts for sensitive data exposure, authorization status, and response actions.

contains_sensitive_or_regulated_data.instructions: Does the telemetry indicate the presence of PII, PHI, payment card data, source code, cryptographic keys, or confidential corporate records?

criteria.true_description: References customer PII, financial records, credentials/keys, proprietary source code, or database dumps.
criteria.false_description: Public documentation, non-sensitive telemetry, or generic web traffic.

is_untrusted_external_destination.instructions: Is the data being transmitted to a personal cloud storage account, unapproved file-sharing service, personal email, or unknown external IP?

criteria.true_description: Destination is personal webmail, consumer cloud storage (Mega, Dropbox, personal Drive), paste site, or non-corporate external endpoint.
criteria.false_description: Destination is a sanctioned corporate tenant, internal repository, or approved partner domain.

dlp_response_action.instructions: What DLP response workflow should be triggered for this event?

criteria.allow_and_log: Authorized business transfer; log for compliance audit only.
criteria.request_user_justification: Ambiguous business transfer; send automated prompt to user and manager for justification.
criteria.block_and_revoke_sharing: Unauthorized external sharing or upload; revoke link permissions and block transfer.
criteria.escalate_insider_threat_ir: High-volume archive staging or deliberate exfiltration of sensitive assets; escalate to Insider Threat & IR.

exfiltration_severity_score.instructions: Rate the data loss and compliance impact severity of this event.
criteria: Negligible: Sanctioned transfer of non-sensitive data.
Low: Minor policy violation (e.g., non-sensitive file sent to personal email).
Moderate: Unapproved transfer of internal business documents requiring remediation.
Severe / Breach Risk: Bulk exfiltration of regulated PII, credentials, or critical intellectual property.

Case Closure & False Positive Gate.description: Evaluates whether an investigated SOAR case or alert is safe for automated false-positive closure and recommends SIEM detection tuning actions.

is_confirmed_benign_pattern.instructions: Based on the alert telemetry and case context, is this activity a recurring benign administrative, scanner, or infrastructure pattern?

criteria.true_description: Activity matches known vulnerability scanners, backup agents, IT automation, or verified benign user workflows.
criteria.false_description: Activity includes unresolved anomalies, unverified external entities, or potential security risks.

is_safe_to_auto_close.instructions: Can this alert be safely closed without further human analyst intervention?

criteria.true_description: All indicators are accounted for as benign with zero residual indicators of compromise.
criteria.false_description: Any ambiguity, unverified indicator, or elevated severity remains that requires human sign-off.

tuning_recommendation.instructions: What Chronicle SIEM detection or SOAR tuning action is recommended to handle similar alerts in the future?

criteria.no_tuning_keep_alerting: Rule logic is sound; keep alerting as normal.
criteria.add_reference_list_exclusion: Exclude the specific benign scanner IP, service account, or host via a Chronicle Reference List.
criteria.refine_yara_l_rule_conditions: Narrow the YARA-L rule condition (e.g., require parent process or command-line filter) to reduce false positives.
criteria.convert_to_silent_detection: Demote rule to non-alerting (NOT_ALERTING) so it remains available for case correlation without generating standalone cases.

reoccurrence_noise_score.instructions: Rate how likely this alert pattern is to generate repetitive false-positive noise across the fleet if left untuned.
criteria: Isolated One-Off: Unlikely to recur.
Occasional: Triggered by periodic manual admin tasks.
Frequent: Triggered daily by automated jobs or subset of hosts.
High-Volume Fleet Noise: Triggered continuously across many endpoints or users.

exclusion_blast_radius_safe.instructions: Is the proposed YARA-L / Curated Rule exclusion narrow and multi-factor enough to avoid suppressing legitimate true-positive detections across the fleet?

criteria.true_description: Narrow multi-factor tuple with compiler verification and acceptable retrospective blast radius.
criteria.false_description: Overly broad single-factor wildcard or unverified rule change that risks blinding detections.
